skirmish.module.anvilcalc.setting.show_b: Show the Calculate button next to the anvil. The AnvilCalc key (Controls → Skirmish) works either way.
skirmish.module.anvilcalc.setting.slot_l: Mark the books of the plan with their letters in the inventory: yellow used, red left out because of the limit, grey not needed.
skirmish.module.anvilcalc.setting.exact_: With at most this many useful books every merge order is checked; with more a fast heuristic is used. 12 books can take a few seconds.
skirmish.module.anvilcalc.setting.too_ex: A single step costing this much or more is refused in survival (vanilla: 40). Change only if the server changes it. Ignored in creative.
skirmish.anvilcalc.stale: The anvil or inventory changed: press Calculate again.
skirmish.anvilcalc.problem.empty: Put the item into the anvil's left slot.
skirmish.anvilcalc.problem.not_enchantab: This item cannot be enchanted on an anvil.
skirmish.anvilcalc.problem.no_books: No enchanted books in your inventory.
skirmish.anvilcalc.problem.nothing: None of your books adds anything to this item.
skirmish.anvilcalc.limited: Not all at once: the cheapest full order has step %s costing %s (limit %s).
skirmish.anvilcalc.limited_none: Even a single step costs %s or more: Too Expensive!
Auto: HolyWorld Lite Anarchy rules on HolyWorld, vanilla rules elsewhere. The client cannot reliably tell Lite from Prime, so pick «HolyWorld Prime» by hand there.
skirmish.anvilcalc.warn.lite_armor: Lite: armour cannot get Mending and cannot be repaired in the anvil. Stinger, Eternity and Infinity armour is repaired with netherite ingots: +25 durability per ingot.
skirmish.anvilcalc.warn.dubious_books: Dubious books %s: applied only on their own to an unenchanted item, never merged with ordinary books. Once applied their level cannot be raised, so level up the book first.
skirmish.anvilcalc.warn.dubious_item: The item carries a dubious enchantment: its level can no longer be raised.
skirmish.anvilcalc.reason.dubious: dubious book, apply on its own
